description: This file implements the pod container management logic for Linux in Kubernetes, including cgroup operations such as creation, deletion, process killing, and resource configuration for pod cgroups.

classes.name: podContainerManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of PodContainerManager interface for managing pod cgroups on Linux.

classes.name: podContainerManagerNoop
classes.description: No-op implementation of PodContainerManager used when cgroup hierarchy is disabled.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the cgroup for a given pod already exists.

methods.name: EnsureExists
methods.description: Ensures the cgroup for a pod exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: GetPodContainerName
methods.description: Returns the cgroup name and its string form for a given pod.

methods.name: GetPodCgroupMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage of the pod's cgroup.

methods.name: GetPodCgroupConfig
methods.description: Gets the resource configuration of the pod's cgroup.

methods.name: SetPodCgroupConfig
methods.description: Sets resource configuration for the pod's cgroup.

methods.name: tryKillingCgroupProcesses
methods.description: Kills all processes attached to a cgroup.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Deletes the cgroup for a pod after killing all processes.

methods.name: ReduceCPULimits
methods.description: Reduces CPU limits for a pod cgroup.

methods.name: IsPodCgroup
methods.description: Determines if a cgroup string corresponds to a pod cgroup.

methods.name: GetAllPodsFromCgroups
methods.description: Scans cgroup mounts to list all existing pod cgroups.
